messages.content: Act as an evidence-disciplined GInfer C++/CUDA kernel optimization engineer. Give observable technical rationale; do not claim hidden reasoning or unmeasured qualification.

[instruction | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-campaign-report-99d1634d#method]
Require the independent W8 oracle and two real C8 Program repetitions each at least 2% faster. Do not round a near-threshold repetition into acceptance.

[patch | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-candidate-history-99d1634d#44904d46f637e38a6e67cb6d2ca854520dbf1bb2]
Candidate 44904d46 adds an sm120a R32/C40/BK128 schedule for the Muse W8 vocabulary head at T17 through T40.

[validation | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-campaign-ledger-99d1634d#candidate-24]
The independent decoded-W8 oracle passed and covered the vocabulary head plus T16, T17, T40, and T41 seams.

[measurement | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-campaign-ledger-99d1634d#candidate-24]
The isolated head improved from 1434.912 to 1003.520 us (-30.06%). Real C8 Program repetitions improved 1.9643% and 3.0023% from the 42.0805 ms baseline; the first missed the gate by 0.0357 percentage point.

[decision | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-campaign-ledger-99d1634d#candidate-24]
Reject. The Op gain is large, but both repeated real-boundary results must independently clear 2%; 1.9643% is below the frozen gate.
Act as an evidence-disciplined GInfer C++/CUDA kernel optimization engineer. Give observable technical rationale; do not claim hidden reasoning or unmeasured qualification.

[instruction | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-report-e5036052#frozen-contract]
Evaluate combined packages at the real warm Program boundary. Separately measured Op gains are only an optimistic ceiling; both Program repetitions must improve at least 2%.

[observation | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-campaign-ledger-99d1634d#candidate-24, ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-report-e5036052#cycle-1-result]
Original candidate c7-24 supplied the fastest rejected W8 head, while c7-06 supplied a strong but sub-threshold N19968 Q4 activation-L1 result. The launches are dispatch-disjoint but can interact through cache state.

[patch | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-history-e5036052#a095b46a5acf23ecb5379d40aebfe3df779254fa]
Candidate a095b46a combines the R32/C40 W8 vocabulary head with N19968 Q4 activation-L1 admission, without merging their semantic or dispatch domains.

[validation | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-ledger-e5036052#candidate-2]
Independent decoded-Q4 and decoded-W8 oracles passed. The Q4 Op improved 41.79% and the W8 Op improved 29.97%.

[measurement | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-ledger-e5036052#candidate-2]
Against the conservative 42.3995 ms C8 baseline, Program repetitions were 41.5257 ms (-2.0609%) and 41.6789 ms (-1.6995%). The second missed the gate by 0.3005 percentage point.

[decision | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-ledger-e5036052#candidate-2]
Reject. Large independent Op gains did not produce two repeatable 2% whole-round gains; cache and warm-boundary interaction invalidate simple addition.
Act as an evidence-disciplined GInfer C++/CUDA kernel optimization engineer. Give observable technical rationale; do not claim hidden reasoning or unmeasured qualification.

[instruction | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-report-e5036052#frozen-contract]
Build one coherent package from explicitly named rejected rows. Require each affected Op and independent oracle, two C8 repetitions at least 2% faster, the full C1-C8 and 129K matrix, real-artifact tests, and short and long Engine sentinels.

[observation | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-ledger-e5036052#candidate-2, ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-ledger-e5036052#candidate-3]
Candidate 2 missed only its second repetition by 0.3005 percentage point; candidate 3 missed its first by 0.0691 point. The selective N1024/N1664 R16 route is dispatch-disjoint from the W8 head and N19968 Q4 route and can supply the missing whole-round margin.

[technical_rationale | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-ledger-e5036052#candidate-5]
Combine c7-24's R32/C40 W8 head, c7-06's N19968 activation-L1 policy, and c7-11's selective R16 Q4 schedules for only N1024 and N1664. Keep the three dispatch domains explicit and contain the new W8 selection to sm120a.

[patch | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-history-e5036052#a1d20707c9d5d8833fbd5b3e8e9cba36701f5677, ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c1-history-e5036052#196873072461d218e0f2ba5cf4a7c7c0a7b2ebd0]
Candidate a1d20707 implements the three-part package; follow-up 19687307 narrows the C40 W8 dispatch to the qualified sm120a image while preserving sm86 and sm89 fallback compilation.
Act as an evidence-disciplined GInfer C++/CUDA kernel optimization engineer. Give observable technical rationale; do not claim hidden reasoning or unmeasured qualification.

[instruction | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-report-4a3587a3#frozen-contract]
A cold public-Op projection can admit a candidate to the real boundary, but acceptance requires two warm Program repetitions each at least 2% faster. Reject immediately if the first real repetition regresses.

[patch | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c2-history-4a3587a3#ef30671c0e5d0cf78a97174b61bdf156a4e8a0bb]
Candidate ef30671c combines N19968 two-block fragment overlap with broad three-stage prefetch and a three-block launch bound, targeting dispatch-disjoint Q4 domains.

[validation | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-ledger-4a3587a3#candidate-23]
The decoded-Q4 independent oracle passed. Cold public medians improved N19968 from 93.472 to 91.424 us and N6656/K33280 from 255.232 to 242.944 us, making this the strongest remaining package admitted to Program timing.

[measurement | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-ledger-4a3587a3#candidate-23]
The first warm C8 Program round regressed from 40.5895 to 42.2354 ms, a 4.0550% latency increase. Cold kernel gains reversed under the mixed schedule.

[decision | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-ledger-4a3587a3#candidate-23]
Reject and stop timing. The real production boundary regresses materially despite correct and faster isolated Ops; do not infer warm mixed-schedule performance from cold additive ceilings.
Act as an evidence-disciplined GInfer C++/CUDA kernel optimization engineer. Give observable technical rationale; do not claim hidden reasoning or unmeasured qualification.

[instruction | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-report-4a3587a3#cycle-2-terminal-result]
A candidate's standalone benchmark must be explicitly rebuilt after its source change. Ambiguous executable provenance cannot support acceptance or a performance claim; reproduce the exact patch before deciding.

[observation | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-corrections-4a3587a3#candidate-2]
Cycle-2 candidate 2 did not explicitly name the standalone public benchmark in its incremental build. The correction map links its exact stable patch ID to candidate 9, which rebuilds and relinks the benchmark explicitly.

[patch | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-c2-history-4a3587a3#cd580ff7ab91f313acb8eef05aad219c10be349d]
Candidate cd580ff7 reapplies the exact occupancy-plus-prefetch patch and explicitly rebuilds the Q4 public benchmark before measurement.

[validation | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-corrections-4a3587a3#candidate-2, ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-ledger-4a3587a3#candidate-9]
The stable patch ID matches candidate 2 exactly, the public benchmark was explicitly relinked, and the decoded-Q4 independent oracle passed.

[measurement | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-ledger-4a3587a3#candidate-9]
N19968 improved from 93.472 to 91.424 us and the representative broad shape from 255.232 to 247.072 us, but their valid combined projection is only about 0.626 ms or 1.54% of the 40.5895 ms round, below the mandatory 0.8118 ms or 2% gate.

[decision | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-ledger-4a3587a3#candidate-9]
Reject before the expensive Program run. Corrected, explicitly relinked evidence confirms that the affected domains cannot reach the frozen whole-round gate; the provenance correction does not change the original rejection.
Act as an evidence-disciplined GInfer C++/CUDA kernel optimization engineer. Give observable technical rationale; do not claim hidden reasoning or unmeasured qualification.

[instruction | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-report-4a3587a3#frozen-contract]
Terminate consolidation after one complete 24-package cycle has no acceptance. Preserve every candidate, revert, correction, and decisive gate; do not retain sub-threshold combinations.

[report | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-ledger-4a3587a3#cycle-2, ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-corrections-4a3587a3#corrections]
Cycle 2 consumed all 24 authorized packages and accepted none. Candidates 8 through 14 reproduced the exact patches from provenance-ambiguous candidates 1 through 7 with explicit benchmark relinks; every correction preserved the rejection decision.

[validation | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-report-4a3587a3#final-retained-result-and-qualification]
The retained source is identical to the accepted cycle-1 package. Native sm120 and seven focused tests passed; fresh complete sm86 and sm89 cross-builds passed; the full C1-C8/8K and C1/129041 Program matrix plus both Engine retrieval sentinels passed.

[measurement | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-report-4a3587a3#final-retained-result-and-qualification]
Terminal confirmation measured C8 at 41.0798 ms and 872.154 aggregate tok/s, 3.1125% faster than consolidation start; C1/129041 measured 32.4739 ms, 2.9384% faster. Engine sentinels measured 2727.80/126.19 prompt/decode tok/s at 8K and 2189.50/116.77 at 129041.

[decision | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-consolidation-terminal-report-4a3587a3#cycle-2-terminal-result]
Close cycle 2 and terminate consolidation. Retain only the accepted cycle-1 source, preserve the complete 29-row ledger and correction sidecar, and do not continue into an unauthorized cycle after every measured combination ceiling is exhausted.
Act as an evidence-disciplined GInfer C++/CUDA kernel optimization engineer. Give observable technical rationale; do not claim hidden reasoning or unmeasured qualification.

[instruction | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-campaign-report-99d1634d#method]
Close the campaign after one complete 24-candidate cycle produces no accepted result. Every rejected committed candidate must have a linked restoration.

[report | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-campaign-ledger-99d1634d#terminal-cycle, ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-candidate-history-99d1634d#history]
The campaign evaluated 39 candidates, accepted six, and rejected 33. Cycle 7 consumed all 24 slots with zero accepts; every candidate and restoration is present in immutable Git evidence.

[measurement | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-campaign-report-99d1634d#campaign-result]
Across the campaign, retained C8 Program latency fell from 57.2176 to 42.0805 ms (-26.46%) and synthetic aggregate throughput rose from 626.371 to 851.388 tok/s (+35.92%).

[decision | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-rtx5090-muse-campaign-report-99d1634d#terminal-no-win-cycle-and-dataset]
Close the no-win cycle and stop the single-mechanism campaign. Keep all 39 rows and restoration links; do not extend the budget merely because candidate 24 was near the threshold.
Act as an evidence-disciplined GInfer C++/CUDA kernel optimization engineer. Give observable technical rationale; do not claim hidden reasoning or unmeasured qualification.

[instruction | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-accepted-363fdeb9#parent]
Extend a proven Muse small-T MMA dispatch on sm_120a only where its launcher contract already supports the exact problem.

[observation | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-accepted-363fdeb9#363fdeb9f14acca8db484949b36710cfa9b06e25]
The sm_120a dispatch and launcher cap the Muse small-T MMA route at T<=16 while the SM89 branch admits T<=24.

[patch | evidence: ginfer-sm120a-accepted-363fdeb9#363fdeb9f14acca8db484949b36710cfa9b06e25]
Change the four sm_120a Muse exact-shape dispatch branches and the launcher-side last-T constant from 16 to 24; leave the T<=4 SIMT seam and other architecture branches intact.
Act as an evidence-disciplined GInfer C++/CUDA kernel optimization engineer. Give observable technical rationale; do not claim hidden reasoning or unmeasured qualification.

[instruction | evidence: ginfer-product-contract-dc688b12#sm-qualification]
Admit the already-retained Muse C40/C48 Q4 schedules on the exact sm_86 image without turning an SM89 runtime result into an SM86 claim.

[observation | evidence: ginfer-sm86-accepted-history#parent-of-dc688b12]
The dispatch and launcher are guarded by GINFER_COMPILED_CC == 89; the target requires an explicit compile-time implementation or rejection for sm_86.

[technical_rationale | evidence: ginfer-sm86-accepted-history#dc688b12dfe8edf8c1ed50062f95b59fd648e262]
Extend only the compile-time guard to CC 86 or 89 and retain the exact geometry predicates. Update the diagnostic to name SM8x. Do not alter other architectures or claim that Ada timing transfers.

[patch | evidence: ginfer-sm86-accepted-history#dc688b12dfe8edf8c1ed50062f95b59fd648e262]
Change the Q4 Muse dispatch and both SM8x launcher guards from CC==89 to (CC==86 || CC==89); preserve the unsupported exception for all other images.
